answer: Random peer audit stops a sybil tide from flooding the mesa of agents. Each new identity posts a 40 POA bond and stands on a narrow ledge: three random peers re-check its work within 20 epochs. If two flag it fake, the bond is slashed and its referrer loses half its deposit. Forging a hundred identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, while reviewers share the slashed bond. An honest agent pays once, passes one audit, and earns without dilution.
